pages.text: Every car gets its own $(l)license plate$(). At a $(item)DMV Office$() you can pay for the $(l)driving test$(), buy a new license card, or buy a $(l)custom plate$() for a car parked nearby.
The test: drive through the DMV's numbered Traffic Cones in order, inside 5 minutes.

Red-light and speed cameras put $(l)penalty points$() on your license; 12 at once suspends it for 3 days. Without a valid license, cameras add a $25 fine, and a $(thing)Police Officer$() with a $(item)Ticket Book$() can fine you.
